# Bleeding edge, 2026-11-14

Every dependency at its newest release and the newest platform features tried out, rebased onto `develop` @ `177dc1e79` by `.github/workflows/bleeding-edge.yml`. The branch keeps its own commits across runs: dependency bumps, fixes and experiments made here ride along on every rebase. The weekly reading of the release notes (what breaks, what's new, what's worth using) is in [ANALYSIS.md](ANALYSIS.md).

**5 of 17 checks fail.** Today 4 direct dependencies moved (0 across a major), 7 transitive. rustc 1.100.0 (0ef1bc386 2026-11-09), Node v26.13.1.
